八项资格条件原文：(a) be aged between 18 and 30 y: The eight conditions verbatim: (a) be aged between 18 and 30 years inclusive at the time of application; (b) employment being an incidental, rather than the primary reason for the visit; (c) no dependants unless they also hold a WHA; (d) a ticket plus EUR 2,500, or EUR 4,000 covering the flight; (e) private medical insurance covering hospitalisation and repatriation; (f) no prior stay in Ireland as a working holidaymaker; (g) not have a criminal record; (h) not already in Ireland under another immigration status. Also: There is no application fee for participation in this programme; the NT$3,200 handling fee goes to the Taipei agent Ms Corina Tsai; maximum stay ... twelve (12) months from the date of initial entry into Ireland with no possibility of extension; stays over 90 days require ISD registration and a fee; the WHA is issued in early 2027 and allows entry at any point before 2027-12-31.
